chunks: Abu Basir asked him about the price of a hunting dog, so he said:
There is no harm in its price, and as for the other, its price is not permissible.

key_terms.أَبُو بَصِيرٍ: Abu Basir, the questioner and narrator in this report
key_terms.الصَّيْدِ: hunting; indicating the dog used for hunting
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; a formula indicating permissibility
key_terms.لَا يَحِلُّ: it is not permissible or lawful

ai.seo_question: Is the price of a hunting dog permissible in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the sale price of a hunting dog, permitting its price. It also distinguishes it from another type of dog, whose price is not lawful.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3647 - Abu Basir asked him about the price of a hunting dog.
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in its price, but as for the other type, its price is not permissible."
